_meta.description: Curated cross-NB claim dependencies. Hook in claim_extractor reads this file and populates 'related_claims' when a new claim matches a known pattern.
_meta.update_policy: Human-curated only. NEVER auto-generate via LLM — risk of allucinated relations. Review required for any change.
_meta.schema: each key is a claim-category selector 'nbX.CATEGORY[.subtopic]'. Value has 'requires_context_from' (consult these categories in other NBs for context) and 'enriches' (these categories elsewhere should be linked back).

keywords: bea perolehan hak atas tanah dan bangunan
nb4.FEE_CHANGE.BPHTB.gloss: BPHTB is a property transfer tax — always needs property-law context from NB-5.

nb4.FEE_CHANGE.PBB.gloss: Property tax recurring — NB-5 defines tax base.

nb4.FEE_CHANGE.PPh_21.gloss: Income tax withholding on salaries — needs employment context from NB-10.

nb4.FEE_CHANGE.PPh_25.gloss: Quarterly tax installment for PT PMA — company-setup context from NB-3.

nb2.LEGAL_CHANGE.KITAS_E23.gloss: Work KITAS requires company sponsor from NB-3 and affects payroll NB-10/tax NB-4.

nb2.LEGAL_CHANGE.KITAS_E28.gloss: Investor KITAS — investment threshold defined in NB-3.

nb2.LEGAL_CHANGE.KITAS_E31.gloss: Family KITAS — affects dependent tax status.

nb2.LEGAL_CHANGE.KITAS_E33.gloss: Second Home / Nomad / Retiree KITAS — enriches NB-8 expat life.

nb5.LEGAL_CHANGE.PP_28_2025.gloss: PP 28/2025 changed property rules for foreigners — ripples into PT PMA investment rules.

nb5.LEGAL_CHANGE.HGB_rules.gloss: HGB title — PT PMA is the typical vehicle (NB-3), triggers property tax (NB-4).

nb5.LEGAL_CHANGE.Hak_Pakai.gloss: Hak Pakai — direct foreigner ownership path, ties to KITAS duration.

nb6.LEGAL_CHANGE.OSS_RBA_changes.gloss: OSS-RBA licensing updates — company-setup NB-3 deeply affected.

nb6.LEGAL_CHANGE.BPJS_rates_2025.gloss: BPJS contribution rate changes — payroll/tax/team trifecta.

nb6.LEGAL_CHANGE.UU_Cipta_Kerja.gloss: Omnibus employment law — PKWT/PKWTT + TKA hire rules.

nb10.ELIGIBILITY_RULE.foreign_hire_proce.gloss: Hiring foreigners: KITAS E23 from NB-2 + labor law from NB-6.

nb10.PROCEDURAL_STEP.payroll_compliance.gloss: Monthly payroll run: tax (PPh 21) + BPJS + THR if annual.

nb3.LEGAL_CHANGE.PT_PMA_capital_threshol.gloss: PT PMA minimum capital — triggers Investor KITAS eligibility.

nb3.LEGAL_CHANGE.PT_PMA_as_owner.gloss: PT PMA as property ownership vehicle — HGB context.

nb8.ELIGIBILITY_RULE.expat_healthcare_co.gloss: Expat healthcare — KITAS type determines BPJS eligibility.

nb7.DOCUMENT_REQUIREMENT.E_E_A_T_for_leg.gloss: YMYL content needs authoritative citations from domain NBs.
